# 1 Enoch Chapter 54 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**54:1** I turned and looked toward another region of the earth, and there I saw a deep valley full of burning fire.

**54:2** The kings and the powerful were being brought and thrown into that burning valley.

**54:3** My eyes saw massive iron chains being forged there — chains of immeasurable weight.

**54:4** I asked the angel of peace beside me: "Who are these chains for?"

**54:5** He said to me: "These chains are being made for the armies of Azazel — they will be bound and thrown into the abyss of absolute condemnation, their mouths packed with rough stones, just as the Lord of Spirits has commanded."

**54:6** "On that great day, Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, and Phanuel will seize them and hurl them into the burning furnace, so that the Lord of Spirits may take his vengeance on them for the evil they did — for submitting to Satan and leading astray the people of the earth."

**54:7** "In those days, punishment will come from the Lord of Spirits. He will open all the reservoirs of water above the heavens and all the springs beneath the earth."

**54:8** "All the waters will merge — the waters above the heavens are the male waters, and the waters below the earth are the female."

**54:9** "Together they will destroy everyone who lives on the earth and everyone who dwells under the farthest reaches of the heavens."

**54:10** "And when they finally confess the wrongs they committed on earth — that is when they will be destroyed by these waters."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Chapter 54 closes the Second Parable with a double judgment: the binding of Azazel's hosts in chains (anticipating Rev 20:1–3), and a new cosmic flood reversing creation. The masculine/feminine waters (v. 8) reflect ancient cosmogony (Gen 1:6–7: the separation of waters). Judgment comes when the primordial separation of waters is undone.*
